title: 分级 · 六级｜证据限定与精确表达 · 60 句
description: 量词范围、信息压缩、研究报告、责任归属、不确定性及条件提案；加强复杂结构与语义精度。

items.zh: “部分项目没有改善”不能改写成“所有项目都没有改善”。
items.en: A lack of improvement in some projects must not be restated as a lack of improvement in all projects.
answers: A lack of improvement in some projects must not be restated as a lack of improvement in all projects.
A lack of improvement in some projects mustn't be restated as a lack of improvement in all projects.
items.notes: some 与 all 的量词范围不同，不能扩大否定。

items.zh: 这项结论适用于接受过培训的参与者，未必适用于初次使用者。
items.en: The conclusion applies to trained participants and cannot necessarily be extended to first-time users.
answers: The conclusion applies to trained participants and cannot necessarily be extended to first-time users.
The conclusion applies to trained participants and can't necessarily be extended to first-time users.
items.notes: be extended to：推广到；necessarily 限定推论强度。

items.zh: 现有记录最多只能说明申请曾被提交，不能说明它得到过批准。
items.en: The available record establishes, at most, that an application was submitted, not that it was approved.
answers: The available record establishes, at most, that an application was submitted, not that it was approved.
items.notes: at most：最多；not that 区分两个从句的证明范围。

items.zh: 我们没有发现足够的理由排除这种解释，但也没有证据确认它。
items.en: We found insufficient grounds to rule out the explanation, yet no evidence to confirm it.
answers: We found insufficient grounds to rule out the explanation, yet no evidence to confirm it.
items.notes: insufficient grounds：不足的理由；排除与确认不是互为否定。

items.zh: “通常如此”允许存在例外，不能被解读为一项没有条件的保证。
items.en: A statement of what usually happens allows exceptions and should not be read as an unconditional guarantee.
answers: A statement of what usually happens allows exceptions and should not be read as an unconditional guarantee.
A statement of what usually happens allows exceptions and shouldn't be read as an unconditional guarantee.
items.notes: allow exceptions：允许例外；unconditional：无条件的。

items.zh: 除非另有说明，下文的费用仅包括日常运营支出。
items.en: Unless otherwise stated, the costs discussed below cover routine operating expenditure only.
answers: Unless otherwise stated, the costs discussed below cover routine operating expenditure only.
items.notes: unless otherwise stated：除非另有说明；only 限定成本范围。

items.zh: 并非每位参与者都完成了全部环节，但所有人至少参加过一次。
items.en: Not every participant completed every stage, although all attended at least once.
answers: Not every participant completed every stage, although all attended at least once.
items.notes: not every、every、all、at least once 分别限定不同范围。

items.zh: 平均效果接近零，并不意味着任何个体都没有受到影响。
items.en: An average effect close to zero does not imply an absence of effects on every individual.
answers: An average effect close to zero does not imply an absence of effects on every individual.
An average effect close to zero doesn't imply an absence of effects on every individual.
items.notes: average effect 与 individual effect 区分总体与个体。

items.zh: 作者只讨论了必要条件，没有声称这些条件本身就已充分。
items.en: The author identifies necessary conditions without claiming that they are sufficient in themselves.
answers: The author identifies necessary conditions without claiming that they are sufficient in themselves.
items.notes: necessary 与 sufficient：必要与充分；in themselves：本身。

items.zh: 两项估算可能都合理，但它们回答的并不是同一个问题。
items.en: Both estimates may be defensible even though they address different questions.
answers: Both estimates may be defensible even though they address different questions.
items.notes: defensible：有合理依据的；even though 保留差异。

items.zh: 所谓“使用门槛”，这里指开始操作之前所需的时间、费用和知识。
items.en: By barriers to use, we mean the time, expense and knowledge required before operation can begin.
answers: By barriers to use, we mean the time, expense and knowledge required before operation can begin.
items.notes: by ... we mean：用……指的是……；将抽象名词展开。

items.zh: 这一变化可以概括为，决策从集中审批转向了明确边界内的自主判断。
items.en: The change amounts to a shift from central approval to discretionary judgement within defined limits.
answers: The change amounts to a shift from central approval to discretionary judgement within defined limits.
items.notes: a shift from ... to ...：从……转向……；discretionary：自主裁量的。

items.zh: 简化后的说明删去了重复部分，但保留了例外条件。
items.en: The condensed explanation removes repetition while preserving the conditions under which exceptions apply.
answers: The condensed explanation removes repetition while preserving the conditions under which exceptions apply.
items.notes: under which 引导例外适用条件；condensed：压缩后的。

items.zh: 文中的“他们”可能指申请者，也可能指审核者，因此需要重新写明主体。
items.en: The pronoun could refer to applicants or reviewers, so the relevant actor needs to be named again.
answers: The pronoun could refer to applicants or reviewers, so the relevant actor needs to be named again.
items.notes: refer to：指代；actor：行为主体。

items.zh: 把两个概念放进同一个标签，可能掩盖它们之间重要的区别。
items.en: Combining two concepts under one label may obscure distinctions essential to understanding them.
answers: Combining two concepts under one label may obscure distinctions essential to understanding them.
items.notes: essential to：对……必不可少；obscure：掩盖。

items.zh: 原文同时描述了时间顺序和原因，摘要不能只保留前者。
items.en: The original describes both sequence and cause; a summary must not retain the former alone.
answers: The original describes both sequence and cause; a summary must not retain the former alone.
The original describes both sequence and cause; a summary mustn't retain the former alone.
items.notes: the former：前者；sequence：顺序；cause：原因。

items.zh: 这句话省略了比较对象，因而“更有效”究竟相对于什么并不清楚。
items.en: The sentence omits the comparator, leaving it unclear what greater effectiveness is measured against.
answers: The sentence omits the comparator, leaving it unclear what greater effectiveness is measured against.
items.notes: comparator：比较对象；leaving it unclear 为结果结构。

items.zh: 定义一个术语时，例子可以辅助说明，却不能总是代替定义本身。
items.en: Examples can support the definition of a term without invariably substituting for the definition itself.
answers: Examples can support the definition of a term without invariably substituting for the definition itself.
items.notes: invariably：总是；substitute for：替代。

items.zh: 为了保持逻辑清楚，修改后的段落把观察结果与解释分开陈述。
items.en: The revised paragraph separates observation from interpretation in the interests of logical clarity.
answers: The revised paragraph separates observation from interpretation in the interests of logical clarity.
items.notes: in the interests of：为了；separate A from B。

items.zh: 名词化能压缩信息，但过多使用会让读者难以看清谁在做什么。
items.en: Nominalisation compresses information, but excessive use can obscure who is acting and what they are doing.
answers: Nominalisation compresses information, but excessive use can obscure who is acting and what they are doing.
items.notes: nominalisation：名词化；两个名词性从句还原主体与行动。

items.zh: 在这一小样本中出现的模式，应被视为值得进一步调查的线索。
items.en: The pattern in this small sample should be treated as a lead for further investigation.
answers: The pattern in this small sample should be treated as a lead for further investigation.
items.notes: be treated as：被视为；lead：线索，不直接当作定论。

items.zh: 观察到的改善与干预时间一致，但数据没有排除季节性影响。
items.en: The observed improvement coincided with the intervention, but the data did not exclude seasonal effects.
answers: The observed improvement coincided with the intervention, but the data did not exclude seasonal effects.
The observed improvement coincided with the intervention, but the data didn't exclude seasonal effects.
items.notes: coincide with：同时发生；exclude：排除。

items.zh: 结果对分析方法的选择较为敏感，因此结论需要谨慎表述。
items.en: The results are sensitive to the analytical method chosen, warranting cautious interpretation.
answers: The results are sensitive to the analytical method chosen, warranting cautious interpretation.
items.notes: be sensitive to：对……敏感；warrant：有必要采取。

items.zh: 两个组在开始时已经存在差异，这使后续比较更难解释。
items.en: Pre-existing differences between the groups complicate the interpretation of subsequent comparisons.
answers: Pre-existing differences between the groups complicate the interpretation of subsequent comparisons.
items.notes: pre-existing：原已存在的；complicate：使复杂。

items.zh: 缺失的回答集中在一个群体，可能影响总体估计。
items.en: Missing responses are concentrated in one group, potentially affecting the overall estimate.
answers: Missing responses are concentrated in one group, potentially affecting the overall estimate.
items.notes: potentially 保留可能性；concentrated in：集中在。

items.zh: 为比较不同量表的结果，研究者将得分标准化，但原始单位的信息也随之丢失。
items.en: Researchers standardised scores to compare results across scales, at the cost of losing information about the original units.
answers: Researchers standardised scores to compare results across scales, at the cost of losing information about the original units.
items.notes: standardise：标准化；at the cost of：以……为代价。

items.zh: 在加入额外变量后，这种联系减弱了，但没有完全消失。
items.en: The association weakened after additional variables were included, though it did not disappear entirely.
answers: The association weakened after additional variables were included, though it did not disappear entirely.
The association weakened after additional variables were included, though it didn't disappear entirely.
items.notes: weakened：减弱；not ... entirely：并未完全。

items.zh: 研究没有记录参与者退出的原因，因此难以判断退出是否具有选择性。
items.en: Reasons for withdrawal were not recorded, making it difficult to assess whether attrition was selective.
answers: Reasons for withdrawal were not recorded, making it difficult to assess whether attrition was selective.
Reasons for withdrawal weren't recorded, making it difficult to assess whether attrition was selective.
items.notes: attrition：样本流失；selective：具有选择性的。

items.zh: 这项发现与先前报告并不矛盾，因为两者使用了不同的结果指标。
items.en: The finding need not contradict earlier reports, since they used different outcome measures.
answers: The finding need not contradict earlier reports, since they used different outcome measures.
The finding needn't contradict earlier reports, since they used different outcome measures.
items.notes: need not：未必；outcome measure：结果指标。

items.zh: 复核支持原先的主要结论，但指出其适用范围比最初声称的更窄。
items.en: The review supports the central conclusion while identifying a narrower scope than originally claimed.
answers: The review supports the central conclusion while identifying a narrower scope than originally claimed.
items.notes: scope：适用范围；than originally claimed 为省略结构。

items.zh: 报告把问题归因于沟通失误，但没有确定失误发生在哪个环节。
items.en: The report attributes the problem to miscommunication without locating the stage at which it occurred.
answers: The report attributes the problem to miscommunication without locating the stage at which it occurred.
items.notes: attribute ... to：归因于；at which 定位环节。

items.zh: 负责执行一项决定，不一定意味着拥有修改该决定的权力。
items.en: Responsibility for implementing a decision does not necessarily confer authority to revise it.
answers: Responsibility for implementing a decision does not necessarily confer authority to revise it.
Responsibility for implementing a decision doesn't necessarily confer authority to revise it.
items.notes: confer authority：赋予权力；区分执行责任与修改权。

items.zh: 文件由某机构保存，并不能单独证明该机构撰写了它。
items.en: Custody of a document does not, on its own, establish authorship by the institution holding it.
answers: Custody of a document does not, on its own, establish authorship by the institution holding it.
Custody of a document doesn't, on its own, establish authorship by the institution holding it.
items.notes: custody：保管；authorship：撰写归属。

items.zh: 该声明代表工作组的共同立场，而非每位成员个人观点的完整呈现。
items.en: The statement represents the working group's shared position, not an exhaustive account of each member's views.
answers: The statement represents the working group's shared position, not an exhaustive account of each member's views.
items.notes: exhaustive account：完整说明；shared position：共同立场。

items.zh: 委托外部人员审查，不会自动免除委托方回应问题的责任。
items.en: Commissioning an external review does not automatically absolve the commissioning body of responsibility to respond.
answers: Commissioning an external review does not automatically absolve the commissioning body of responsibility to respond.
Commissioning an external review doesn't automatically absolve the commissioning body of responsibility to respond.
items.notes: absolve ... of ...：免除……责任；commission：委托。

items.zh: 引用他人的批评并不等于赞同，但引文的安排可能让读者产生这种印象。
items.en: Quoting criticism does not constitute endorsement, although its placement may create that impression.
answers: Quoting criticism does not constitute endorsement, although its placement may create that impression.
Quoting criticism doesn't constitute endorsement, although its placement may create that impression.
items.notes: constitute endorsement：构成赞同；although 补充语境效果。

items.zh: 除非记录中有明确证据，否则不应推断某人参与了最终决定。
items.en: Participation in the final decision should not be inferred unless the record provides explicit evidence.
answers: Participation in the final decision should not be inferred unless the record provides explicit evidence.
Participation in the final decision shouldn't be inferred unless the record provides explicit evidence.
items.notes: be inferred：被推断；unless 引出所需依据。

items.zh: 签字确认查阅过文件，与确认其中每项陈述都正确，是不同的承诺。
items.en: Acknowledging that a document has been read entails a different commitment from certifying every statement as correct.
answers: Acknowledging that a document has been read entails a different commitment from certifying every statement as correct.
items.notes: acknowledge 与 certify 区分确认性质；entail：意味着。

items.zh: 责任在多方之间分配，并不意味着无人需要解释结果。
items.en: Distributing responsibility among several parties does not eliminate the need for someone to account for the outcome.
answers: Distributing responsibility among several parties does not eliminate the need for someone to account for the outcome.
Distributing responsibility among several parties doesn't eliminate the need for someone to account for the outcome.
items.notes: account for：解释并说明责任；among：多方之间。

items.zh: 更正应说明改变了哪项判断，而不只是替换旧文件。
items.en: A correction should identify the judgement revised rather than merely substitute a new document.
answers: A correction should identify the judgement revised rather than merely substitute a new document.
items.notes: judgement revised：被修订的判断；merely：仅仅。

items.zh: 根据现有资料，这一解释比其他解释更有可能，但仍非唯一可能。
items.en: On the available evidence, this explanation is more plausible than its alternatives without being the only possibility.
answers: On the available evidence, this explanation is more plausible than its alternatives without being the only possibility.
items.notes: plausible：合理可信的；without 限定确定程度。

items.zh: 我们预期效果会持续，不过这一预期尚未经过长期观察检验。
items.en: We expect the effect to persist, though that expectation remains untested by long-term observation.
answers: We expect the effect to persist, though that expectation remains untested by long-term observation.
items.notes: expectation 回指预期；untested：未经检验的。

items.zh: 不能排除风险与已经发现风险，并不是同一种证据状态。
items.en: Being unable to exclude a risk is not equivalent to having identified one.
answers: Being unable to exclude a risk is not equivalent to having identified one.
Being unable to exclude a risk isn't equivalent to having identified one.
items.notes: be equivalent to：等同于；having done 表已完成识别。

items.zh: 这项建议取决于目前的成本估算，估算若改变，建议也需要重审。
items.en: The recommendation is contingent on current cost estimates and would need reconsideration if they changed.
answers: The recommendation is contingent on current cost estimates and would need reconsideration if they changed.
items.notes: be contingent on：取决于；would ... if 表假设变化。

items.zh: 作者似乎倾向于支持方案，但措辞还不足以表明明确赞同。
items.en: The author appears sympathetic to the proposal, yet the wording falls short of explicit approval.
answers: The author appears sympathetic to the proposal, yet the wording falls short of explicit approval.
items.notes: sympathetic to：倾向支持；fall short of：尚未达到。

items.zh: “可能导致”保留了其他结果的空间，不宜被替换为“必然导致”。
items.en: The phrase 'may lead to' leaves room for other outcomes and should not be replaced by 'will inevitably cause'.
answers: The phrase 'may lead to' leaves room for other outcomes and should not be replaced by 'will inevitably cause'.
The phrase 'may lead to' leaves room for other outcomes and shouldn't be replaced by 'will inevitably cause'.
items.notes: may 与 will inevitably 的确定性不同；引号标出讨论的短语。

items.zh: 目前更稳妥的结论是值得试验，而不是应该立即全面采用。
items.en: The more defensible conclusion is that a trial is warranted, not that immediate universal adoption is justified.
answers: The more defensible conclusion is that a trial is warranted, not that immediate universal adoption is justified.
items.notes: defensible：更有依据的；warranted：值得采取的。

items.zh: 即便估算存在误差，只要方案排序不变，决策也可能仍然稳健。
items.en: A decision may remain robust despite estimation errors if the ranking of options is unchanged.
answers: A decision may remain robust despite estimation errors if the ranking of options is unchanged.
items.notes: robust：稳健的；despite 与 if 分别引出让步和条件。

items.zh: 缺少反对意见可能意味着认可，也可能反映提出异议的困难。
items.en: An absence of objections may indicate approval or reflect obstacles to expressing dissent.
answers: An absence of objections may indicate approval or reflect obstacles to expressing dissent.
items.notes: dissent：异议；or 提供替代解释。

items.zh: 在资料进一步完善之前，建议应保留调整余地。
items.en: Recommendations should remain open to revision pending a fuller body of evidence.
answers: Recommendations should remain open to revision pending a fuller body of evidence.
items.notes: pending：在等待……期间；a body of evidence：一组证据。

items.zh: 只有在监督资源同步增加时，扩大服务承诺才有可信的执行基础。
items.en: Only if oversight resources expand alongside provision does the commitment acquire a credible basis for implementation.
answers: Only if oversight resources expand alongside provision does the commitment acquire a credible basis for implementation.
items.notes: only if 置首，主句部分倒装；oversight：监督。

items.zh: 假如费用最终由申请者承担，原先关于普遍可及的判断就需要重新考虑。
items.en: Were applicants ultimately to bear the costs, the original claim of universal access would need reconsideration.
answers: Were applicants ultimately to bear the costs, the original claim of universal access would need reconsideration.
items.notes: Were ... to ... 为假设条件倒装；bear costs：承担费用。

items.zh: 方案越依赖未经检验的假设，就越需要保留中途退出的安排。
items.en: The more a proposal relies on untested assumptions, the greater the need for an exit option.
answers: The more a proposal relies on untested assumptions, the greater the need for an exit option.
items.notes: the more ... the greater ...：越……越需要……。

items.zh: 若要试点结果支持推广，评估就必须说明哪些条件能在其他地点重现。
items.en: For pilot results to justify expansion, the evaluation must identify which conditions can be reproduced elsewhere.
answers: For pilot results to justify expansion, the evaluation must identify which conditions can be reproduced elsewhere.
items.notes: for ... to ... 引出目标成立条件；which 从句限定条件。

items.zh: 一项看似中立的要求，只有放到具体使用者的生活条件中才可能显示出其负担。
items.en: Not until an apparently neutral requirement is considered in users' circumstances may its burden become apparent.
answers: Not until an apparently neutral requirement is considered in users' circumstances may its burden become apparent.
items.notes: not until 置首主句倒装；apparently：表面上。

items.zh: 我们需要的并非更多无法追踪的承诺，而是能让责任与结果对应起来的记录。
items.en: What is needed is a record linking responsibility to outcomes, rather than additional commitments that cannot be traced.
answers: What is needed is a record linking responsibility to outcomes, rather than additional commitments that cannot be traced.
What is needed is a record linking responsibility to outcomes, rather than additional commitments that can't be traced.
items.notes: what 主语从句；linking 修饰 record；定语从句限定承诺。

items.zh: 如果支持者承认成本而批评者承认收益，分歧就可能集中到真正需要权衡的部分。
items.en: Should advocates acknowledge costs and critics acknowledge benefits, disagreement may narrow to the trade-offs that actually matter.
answers: Should advocates acknowledge costs and critics acknowledge benefits, disagreement may narrow to the trade-offs that actually matter.
items.notes: Should 条件倒装；narrow to：缩小到。

items.zh: 任何规定都不可能预见所有情况，因此制度必须说明未被覆盖的情形由谁判断。
items.en: No rule can anticipate every circumstance; arrangements must therefore specify who judges cases falling outside its coverage.
answers: No rule can anticipate every circumstance; arrangements must therefore specify who judges cases falling outside its coverage.
items.notes: who 名词性从句；falling outside 限定未覆盖情形。

items.zh: 即使没有一家机构能够独自承担全部任务，也不意味着共同安排无法建立。
items.en: That no single institution can undertake the whole task does not entail that a joint arrangement is impossible.
answers: That no single institution can undertake the whole task does not entail that a joint arrangement is impossible.
That no single institution can undertake the whole task doesn't entail that a joint arrangement is impossible.
items.notes: that 引导主语从句；entail that：意味着……。

items.zh: 只有把可接受的误差范围说清楚，我们才可能判断何时需要重新审查决定。
items.en: Only by specifying a tolerable margin of error can we determine when a decision requires review.
answers: Only by specifying a tolerable margin of error can we determine when a decision requires review.
items.notes: only by 置首主句倒装；when 从句为判断对象。
